comments.text:
REVIEW: VERDICT = OK (no blocking findings). BOB-002 batch on branch features/BOB-002. Validation: 413 tests pass, 98% coverage, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (46 files), beadloom lint --strict = 0 violations, beadloom doctor/reindex ok.

DIMENSION RESULTS (all PASS):

1) CORRECTNESS = PASS.
- aiogram migration preserves behavior: dedup via _seen_update_ids + offset advance (max(offset, update_id+1)) identical to BOB-001; draft streaming batches by batch_tokens, throttles via injected clock/sleep, backs off on TelegramRetryAfter (gateway.py:332-377).
- Rich path: MarkdownToRichMessage -> RichMessageSerializer -> send_rich_message; on any AiogramError/ValueError it degrades to plain send_message with length-split (gateway.py:381-403, 477-498). RichBlockThinking rendered as leading collapsible block when thinking present (rich.py:102-113). Empty reply with no thinking sends nothing.
- retry.py: is_transient classifies aiohttp ClientConnectionError (covers ServerDisconnectedError) + TimeoutError + 5xx as transient; everything else permanent and re-raised at once; CancelledError re-raised; bounded by max_attempts with exponential backoff (retry.py:50-111). Provider uses aiohttp so the classification matches the real client.
- Tick isolation: periodic() re-raises CancelledError, logs+continues on Exception, wraps tick in retry_with_backoff when a RetryPolicy is given (heartbeat.py:76-101). One bad tick cannot kill the loop or its siblings.
- Tool-loop TERMINATES: bounded by _DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=6, returns final text when no tool_calls, returns '' + warns on cap (tool_loop.py:61-73). Unknown capability fed back as tool error message; any dispatch Exception caught + logged so a tool failure never crashes the turn (tool_loop.py:75-91). Empty-registry path UNCHANGED: HandleMessage engages the loop only when a tool provider is wired AND registry is non-empty, else the plain router path (handle_message.py:191-203).

2) ARCHITECTURE (DDD/Clean) = PASS.
- New ports Capability, ToolCallingProvider, AllowlistStore (+ ToolCall/ToolCallResult value objects) all live in domain/ports.py. Gateway/persistence/llm stay in infrastructure; composition only in app.py.
- Gateway depends on application only via a structural AuthorizerLike Protocol + the MessageReceived event import (infra -> application is allowed); it never imports the concrete Authorizer (gateway.py:131-141).
- beadloom lint --strict = 0 violations; the layering guard test (tests/application/test_layering.py) holds and passed.

3) SECURITY (KEY) = PASS.
- Authz, single enforcement point: the ONLY gate is TelegramGateway.intake/_passes_gate (gateway.py:202-250). Dedup -> gate -> publish; no other path publishes MessageReceived. is_authorized is checked BEFORE owner-command handling, so an unauthorized update can never reach /authorize. Disallowed chat OR unauthorized user -> silently dropped (no MessageReceived, no reply).
- /authorize is owner-only: _handle_owner_command returns False unless is_owner(user_id); a non-owner's /authorize text simply falls through as an ordinary message (per RFC) (gateway.py:252-273).
- Chat-scope binds even the owner: Authorizer.is_authorized rejects any chat outside allowed_chat_ids for everyone (authorizer.py:53-65) -> a leaked token in a foreign chat is dead. Fail-closed defaults: owner_id=0 + empty allowed_chat_ids authorizes nobody.
- Token/ids from config/env only (app.py _build_real_bot/_build_authorizer; config/bob.example.yaml documents BOB_TELEGRAM__TOKEN etc.). Never inlined. Drop log records only user_id/chat_id, never the token/text (gateway.py:244-248).
- Tool-loop abuse: recall_memory is permission='safe', validates that 'query' is a str and raises otherwise (recall_memory.py:69-75). FTS injection sanitization HOLDS: _to_match_query tokenizes to word chars, drops operator punctuation, quotes each term, OR-joins; SQL is fully parameterized (fts_recall.py:59-111). A model-driven query cannot inject FTS operators or SQL.
- Privacy: capability results flow back as 'tool' messages within the same turn; HandleMessage keeps the BOB-001 Variant-2 split (shareable_context MAY reach Tier 1, private_context stays Tier-0-only and is empty in P0.1). No new private->Tier1 leak introduced (handle_message.py:173-216).

4) STANDARDS = PASS. Clock/sleep injected throughout (SystemClock, _async_sleep, _monotonic); parameterized SQL only; no print; no bare except (the two broad 'except Exception' in tool_loop/heartbeat are justified with comments, log via logger.exception, and re-raise CancelledError); secrets never logged; mypy --strict + ruff clean.

NON-BLOCKING NOTES (author discretion, not requiring a fix cycle):
- Nitpick (pre-existing, NOT a BOB-002 regression): _seen_update_ids grows unbounded over a 24/7 process. Confirmed identical on main (BOB-001). Since the poll offset advances past handled updates, dedup mainly guards in-batch redelivery; a bounded structure (e.g. deque maxlen) would be tidier. Out of scope for this batch.
- Info: beadloom sync-check reports architecture.md stale for the new/changed modules. This is EXPECTED and is exactly the work assigned to BEAD-10 (tech-writer, blocked on this review). Not a defect of the dev work; flagging so BEAD-10 covers all listed symbols (authz, capabilities/registry+tool_loop+recall_memory, runtime/retry, allowlist_store, telegram/rich+gateway, ports, app).

CONCLUSION: arrow OK. No Critical/Major/Minor findings. Special-attention items (authz bypass, tool-loop termination/abuse) both verified clean.

REVIEW (BEAD-09) — BOB-001 P0 slice (7 dev beads + test). Read-only. Verdict: ISSUES (1 Major, 2 Minor). Gates reproduced green locally: 216 pytest pass, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict 0 violations, sync-check rc0.

DIMENSION VERDICTS
- Correctness: PASS. perceive->decide->act->persist flow correct (handle_message.py). Tier1->Tier0 fallback correct and, crucially, the payload is built ONCE (llm_router.run -> _build_messages) so the redacted Tier-1 payload is exactly what the Tier-0 fallback sends — privacy holds on the fallback path too (explicitly tested: test_fallback_to_tier0_still_redacts_personal_context). Genesis idempotent via on-disk SOUL.md flag (run_genesis.run short-circuits, no LLM/file touch); malformed Tier1 output rejected loudly (GenesisError; 3 hardening tests). Mood/Taste/Negotiation pure + deterministic + bounded; heartbeat ticks (InnerMonologue feeds Mood, MoodDrift homeostasis, Reflect logs episode) correct and error-isolated in periodic().
- Security/Privacy: PASS. Redaction by construction: LLMRouter._build_messages attaches personal_context ONLY when the task's preferred tier is Tier 0 (stays_local); a Tier-1-bound request is never given the raw context. Asserted by unit + e2e privacy tests (recall-secret + phantom-secret never reach Tier 1). Secrets: telegram.token and llm.tier1_api_key come from config/env only (factory._optional_str, app._build_real_bot) — never inlined; no Authorization header when key absent (Tier 0). yaml.safe_load everywhere (loader, run_genesis). All SQL parameterized (?) — sqlite_repo.py is the single SQL home; FTS user text tokenized to OR-of-quoted-terms (fts_recall._to_match_query) — injection/syntax safe. pathlib throughout.
- Standards (CONTEXT.md): PASS. datetime.now() appears ONLY inside SystemClock.now() in app.py; everywhere else the injected Clock is used. No print(), no bare except, no mutable defaults. Domain dataclasses frozen+slots with invariant checks in __post_init__. Type hints on public surfaces.

FINDINGS

Major 1 — Architecture: application layer imports concrete infrastructure types (violates infra->application->domain).
- src/bob/application/usecases/handle_message.py:45 — 'from bob.infrastructure.telegram.events import MessageReceived'
- src/bob/application/usecases/run_genesis.py:44 — 'from bob.infrastructure.persistence.soul_store import JsonValue, SoulStore'
Why: declared layering is infrastructure -> application -> domain; the application must not depend on infrastructure. Both imports are TYPE_CHECKING-only (no runtime cycle, wiring still in app.py), but they are a real layering leak AND directly contradict this layer's own stated invariant — application/__init__.py docstring says it 'never imports bob.infrastructure'. So either the code or the documented invariant is wrong.
Recommendation: move the transport event + persistence contract the use-cases depend on to a layer the application owns. (a) Define MessageReceived (or a MessageReceivedLike Protocol carrying chat_id/text/sender_name) in domain/ports or application; the telegram gateway produces it, the use-case consumes the abstraction. (b) RunGenesis should depend on a SoulStore *port* (Protocol) declared in domain/application, with the concrete Sqlite/file SoulStore bound in app.py; JsonValue likewise belongs with that port, not imported from persistence. Net: zero application->infrastructure imports, restoring the docstring's invariant.

Minor 1 — Architecture/graph: beadloom lint --strict evaluated only 1 rule and the entire src/bob tree is annotated as a single 'beadloom:domain=bob' node, so the graph has no layer sub-model and CANNOT enforce the infra/app/domain boundary (it did not catch Major 1). The hexagon is real in the source but invisible to the tool. Recommendation (for the tech-writer/graph bead BEAD-10): introduce per-layer beadloom nodes (domain / application / infrastructure) + a forbid-import rule application->infrastructure so the boundary is machine-checked, not just convention.

Minor 2 — Typing consistency: src/bob/app.py _PtbBotAdapter.get_updates (l.406) and send_message (l.409) carry '# type: ignore[no-untyped-def]' and omit return annotations, while edit_message_text (l.412) is annotated '-> object'. The ignores at the PTB boundary are justified, but annotate the two return types (-> Sequence[UpdateLike] / -> _MessageLike or object) to drop the no-untyped-def ignores and match the third method.

Nitpick — tests/application/usecases/test_run_genesis_hardening.py imports the private _parse_personality. Acceptable (it tests the validation contract) but a public seam would be cleaner.

RESULT: ISSUES — 0 critical, 1 major, 2 minor. Do NOT merge until Major 1 (application->infrastructure layering leak) is fixed; coordinator to open a fix-bead. Minor 1 fits naturally into the BEAD-10 graph/docs work.
